claims.statement: Tom Allen accompanied Charley Mitchell into the ring at the Olympic Club, New Orleans, with Frank Slavin and Pat Allen, before Mitchell's sparring bout.
claims.excerpt:
Mitche!! was accompanied by Frank Slavin,
Tom Allen and Pat Allen.

notes: Hint said 'exhibition'; by the rules this is seconding another man's bout, so kind is other. The crowd reaction to Allen is not recorded.
